button-press.reduced: No scale. The pressed color carries the state.

segment-press.reduced: No dip. The pressed color carries the state.

button-loading.reduced: The label and the spinner cross fade over duration.base. The button does not move.

copy-swap.reduced: The old icon fades out while the new one fades in, over duration.base. The button does not move.

button-nudge.reduced: The end part stays still. The hover color carries the state.

close-turn.reduced: The glyph does not turn. The hover fill carries the state.

split-chevron.reduced: The chevron points up at once and does not drop on hover.

fab-morph.reduced: The plus shows as a close mark at once; the label shows at once.

toggle-pop.reduced: No pop. The on fill and the ring carry the state.

switch-stretch.reduced: The thumb jumps to the other side and does not stretch; the track does not dip; the tint shows at once.

link-underline.reduced: The line shows and goes at once; the icon stays still.

focus-glow.reduced: The ring and the glow show at once and do not grow (every duration token is 0ms, the start scale is 1).

error-shake.reduced: No motion. The error color and the Field message carry the state.

field-error-enter.reduced: The message fades in; the icon does not move.

password-reveal.reduced: The glyphs and the text cross fade, with no turn.

search-clear.reduced: The glyph fades in; the copy fades out.

otp-caret.reduced: The caret shows at once in its cell.

field-step.reduced: The new digits fade in, with no travel.

scrub-roll.reduced: The digits fade in; the handle does not grow.

form-submit-success.reduced: No motion. The status message says the form was sent.

wizard-step.reduced: The steps cross fade, with no travel; the marks do not move.

consent-check.reduced: No pop. The mark shows as the Checkbox draws it.

rating-fill.reduced: The new stars fade in; stars that empty change at once.

rating-preview.reduced: The preview color changes at once with no dip.
